newsitem.title: CHINA: Nichimen in 10 bln yen China subway deal.
newsitem.headline: Nichimen in 10 bln yen China subway deal.

text.p: A group including Japan's Nichimen Corp has won a 10 billion yen order for equipment for a subway project in China's capital Beijing, the Business Weekly said on Sunday.
Beijing subway authorities had signed the deal with Nichimen, Japan's Toyo Electric Manufacturing Co Ltd and China International Trust and Investment Corp, it said.
The contract called for the supply of 174 rail cars as well as control and brake systems with concessional yen loan financing, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
